audit_mode.scope: local nts11 ordered S10 trace, sealed M51/M40/M216/M233 artifacts, checkpoint, and ATLIF DP-TME vectors

decision_summary.g7: NO_GO_MAIN_AXIS: official emitted/operator sources in the audited exact-binary domains contain no positive-distance values at theta <= 0.125
decision_summary.g8: NO_GO_FROM_CURRENT_DATA: real token-level FFN residual and branch tensors were not retained; aggregate BN ranges do not prove bypass safety
decision_summary.g11: GO_CPU_ONLY_SCREEN_FOR_FC1_AND_SIX_PATCH_RESIDUAL_CONVS: local bitpacks plus the frozen checkpoint permit a tighter source-local contribution-bound screen; executable cycles and accuracy remain unadmitted
decision_summary.g12: GO_MECHANISM_PROTOTYPE_ONLY_ON_CURATED_DP_TME_VECTORS: representative S10 opportunity requires a new streaming hook and paired modified forward
decision_summary.paper_contribution_rule: G7 and G11 are one contribution family, not two independent contributions

metric_definitions.positive_distance_dropped_source: an element satisfying 0 < abs(x) <= theta; pre-existing zeros are excluded from incremental drop
metric_definitions.ideal_k8_source_issue_proxy: for each token and destination group, max over source banks of active-source popcount, summed over groups; assumes one issue per bank per cycle and excludes stalls, memory, accumulator and commit
metric_definitions.tight_source_local_bound: sum over skipped sources of abs(w_i * x_i) for a specified destination or destination group in an explicitly named arithmetic domain
metric_definitions.operator_denominator: exact input_elements/input_active or token/source population for the named layer and frozen cohort; it is not a cycle denominator

theta_grid_exact_binary_scope.scope: M51 exact-binary inputs only: 31 modules, 310 hook calls, S10; includes FC1/FC2/downsample/patch-residual Conv/pred targets but not analog ATLIF inputs, attention projections, FFN residuals, or unhooked operators
theta_grid_exact_binary_scope.predicate_contract: every retained source is exactly numeric 0 or 1; no tolerance, threshold, or nonzero coercion
theta_grid_exact_binary_scope.interpretation: the zero bound is rigorous but vacuous: the grid removes no additional official source work

official_atlif_output_amplitude_scope.output_alphabet: zero or the per-site threshold magnitude
official_atlif_output_amplitude_scope.warning: this conclusion applies to official ATLIF outputs, not the analog pre-threshold h/input values

g7_g11_mechanism_deduplication.g7_algorithmic_predicate: keep_G7(i,g) = 1{abs(x_i) > theta}, identical for every destination group g
g7_g11_mechanism_deduplication.g11_algorithmic_predicate: keep_G11(i,g) = 1{a stated bound on abs(w_ji*x_i) for destination group g exceeds its budget}
g7_g11_mechanism_deduplication.relationship: G7 is the destination-independent broadcast-mask special case of G11
shared_hardware: mask compactor and K8 source-bank executor
g7_g11_mechanism_deduplication.paper_rule: claim one bounded-contribution gate plus destination-group sparse executor; report G7 as a degenerate-mode ablation, not a second contribution
g7_g11_mechanism_deduplication.analog_g7_caveat: placing G7 before ATLIF threshold changes neuron semantics and requires new hooks and accuracy validation; this placement difference alone does not make it an independent hardware contribution

atlif_semantic_finding.official_module: PSN-style temporal affine aggregation followed by threshold

atlif_semantic_finding.fail_closed_requirement: the runtime proof may not consume all future products merely to prove they can be skipped; bound metadata, source ranges, issue order and its hardware cost must be explicit
